title: 第5章 你连英语都会还说不是间谍第6章 你家没关系还不滚去给我做饭
slug: 提蓝桥刚毕业女帝求我当宰相
content_zh:
;;
尼玛，这狗世界有毒呀！
感受到脖颈处再度传来死亡气息。
沈浪真的想要问候贼老天，是不是特么的欠？
别人穿越，不是王侯将相，就是纨绔少爷。
他穿越，一个小小的衙役也就罢了。
就连家里的婆娘，都特么想造.反。
这还真的是，欺人太甚！
只是，原主的媳妇不是痴傻之人吗？
为毛此刻看着，比霸道女总裁，还要难缠呀？
难不成，媳妇也被穿了？
想到这里。
沈浪决定试试：“howareyou？”
此话一出。
神霄的脸色骤变。
沈浪却是心头狂喜。
这便宜媳妇果真也被穿了。
接下来，他岂不是可以毫不费力的解锁很多现代姿势？
就在沈浪准备跟老乡聊聊家常时……
本名上官冉的短发女子，猛地一脚把沈浪踹翻在地。

厉声爆喝：“想不到你这狗男人，竟然是大亓王朝的间谍，简直是该死至极！”
我尼玛，这什么情况？
有些懵逼的沈浪，眼见上官冉似乎想杀了自己。
也是忙不迭的冲着神霄喊道：“我说老妹，你踏马倒是说句话呀，我什么时候成大亓王朝间谍了？”
见沈浪都这种时候了，还敢嘴硬。
神霄的眼眸之中，也闪过一缕杀机：“连大亓王朝的话都会说，还不承认你是大亓王朝的间谍吗？”
“啊？”
听到这个原因，沈浪人都傻了！
他只是想用英语对个暗号，怎么也没有想到，还能跟这个世界对上。
意识到，贼老天这是要玩死自己的沈浪。
也是豁出去道：“媳妇，误会呀！”
content_en:
;;
Damn, this dog world is poisonous!
I felt the breath of death coming from my neck again.
Shen Lang really wants to greet the thief God, is he so indebted?
Others who travel through time are either princes, generals, ministers, or dandy young masters.
He traveled through time and was nothing more than a small government servant.
Even the mother-in-law at home really wants to rebel.
This is really too much!
But isn’t the original owner’s wife a foolish person?
Why is Mao looking at him now, more difficult to deal with than the overbearing female CEO?
Is it possible that the wife was also penetrated?
Think of this.
Shen Lang decided to try: "howareyou?"
As soon as these words came out.
Shen Xiao's expression suddenly changed.
Shen Lang was ecstatic.
This cheap wife is indeed worn.
Next, wouldn't he be able to unlock many modern postures effortlessly?
Just when Shen Lang was about to chat with his fellow villagers about their daily life...
The short-haired woman whose real name was Shangguan Ran suddenly kicked Shen Lang to the ground.
He yelled sternly: "I never thought you, a bitch like you, could be a spy of the Qi Dynasty. You deserve to die!"
Damn it, what's going on?
Shen Lang was a little confused and saw that Shangguan Ran seemed to want to kill him.
He also hurriedly shouted to Shenxiao: "Sister, you are just saying something when you are riding a horse. When did I become a spy of the Qi Dynasty?"
Seeing Shen Lang in such a state, he still dared to speak harshly.
A hint of murderous intent flashed through Shen Xiao's eyes: "You can even speak the words of the Daqi Dynasty, but you still don't admit that you are a spy of the Daqi Dynasty?"
"Huh?"
Hearing this reason, Shen Langren was dumbfounded!
He just wanted to exchange a code in English. He never thought that he could still interact with this world.
He realized that God was trying to kill Shen Lang.
He also bravely said: "Daughter-in-law, there is a misunderstanding!"
